name: gorgon
lore:
Imagine stumbling upon a creature of nightmare, a monstrous bull wreathed in dusky, metallic scales that shimmer ominously in the dim light of its underground lair. This is the gorgon, a beast of immense size and raw power, its very breath a harbinger of stone. Its eyes, cold and animalistic, fixate on you, and a guttural bellow rumbles from deep within its chest, a prelude to the deadly vapor it is about to unleash.

Few survive an encounter with a gorgon, their bodies forever frozen in silent terror, transformed into lifeless statues. These creatures, possessing only animalistic intelligence, are driven by instinct and aggression, attacking any who dare trespass upon their territory. Tales speak of entire adventuring parties turned to stone, their heroic quests abruptly ended by the gorgon's petrifying breath. The gorgon roams its territory, a walking monument to destruction, leaving behind a trail of calcified victims.

Yet, even in death, the gorgon's power lingers. Alchemists and mages seek its blood and scales, rare components for powerful enchantments and protective wards. But beware, for tampering with the remains of such a creature is a perilous endeavor. The gorgon's legacy is one of fear and petrification, a reminder that some beasts are best left undisturbed in the dark depths of the world.
